integrity: A full acyclic discrete-Morse matching for both explicit graphs is reproduced by the standalone standard-library script; graph-classification and previously known rook topology are acknowledged rather than claimed as discoveries.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification at graph Čech scale two only; the two-isomorphism-type theorem is classical and the rook-graph homotopy type was previously published. No claim for other parameters or scales; a bibliographically unindexed equivalent Shrikhande result cannot be excluded.
title: Scale-two Čech homotopy distinguishes the Shrikhande and rook graphs
